items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Boca, mazooka, and so, you know. Chaudrill.

ctx.x: Would the brass bands play mazookas? Ask it. Did the brass bands play mazookas? Did what? Did the brass bands play mazookas? Anything.
Boca, mazooka, and so, you know. Chaudrill. Chaudrill. Chaudrill. Chaudrill. Chaudrill. Chaudrill. Waltz. Mm-hmm.
They played waltz. Waltz. Chaudrill. Chaudrill.
